title: Close the three retry-findings residuals from the WA-A5B-FUP1 review

outcome.summary: The dispatch attach step refuses every shape it cannot resolve to exactly one gated failure: a truthy non-string explicit failure_id is refused instead of resolving to an empty id, and a brief whose explicit failure_id and retry_of-resolved failure id disagree is refused before anything reaches the launcher. The retry_of-resolved id path gains the same supplied-block preservation pin AC-003 already has on the explicit-id path. Every valid path keeps its current behaviour.
observable_behavior: `tools._gated_failure_id({"failure_id": 5}, state)` raises ResearchGateError with code research_required and a message naming failure_id as needing a string, instead of returning the empty string.

`tools._attach_accepted_findings({"failure_id": 5, "findings": <block for another failure>}, state)` returns the typed error envelope (ok false, code research_required) and the stray block does not survive into any returned brief.
A supplied findings block that names the failure resolved through retry_of is preserved byte-identically (same object) instead of being replaced by the stored artifact.

A brief whose explicit failure_id resolves to failure A and whose retry_of resolves to failure B is refused by research_gate.require_findings with code research_required, and the message names both ids.
tools._dispatch of that contradictory brief returns ok false with code research_required and makes zero launcher create calls.
A brief whose explicit failure_id and retry_of name the same failure is still accepted: the gate returns None and the attach step preserves the supplied block.

interfaces.name: bundlebees_plugin.tools._gated_failure_id
interfaces.notes: Refuse a truthy non-string explicit id with ResearchGateError instead of returning ""; return None (no id) only when neither id resolves.

interfaces.name: bundlebees_plugin.tools._attach_accepted_findings
interfaces.notes: Propagate the refusal as the typed error envelope; no other branch changes.

interfaces.name: bundlebees_plugin.research_gate.require_findings
interfaces.notes: Refuse when the explicit failure id and the retry_of-resolved failure id disagree, naming both; one id or two equal ids keep today's behaviour.

interfaces.name: tests/test_retry_findings_paths.py
interfaces.notes: Approved RED specification; read-only for the implementer. WA-A5B-FUP1's tests/test_retry_findings_attach_scope.py stays untouched.

acceptance_criteria.statement: a truthy non-string explicit failure_id is refused by the helper with research_required instead of resolving to an empty id
the attach step refuses a non-string failure_id as the typed error envelope and the caller's block for another failure does not survive
a supplied findings block that names the retry_of-resolved failure is preserved byte-identically
a brief whose explicit failure_id and retry_of-resolved failure id disagree is refused with research_required naming both ids
dispatch of the disagreeing brief returns the typed refusal and makes no launcher call
a brief whose explicit failure_id and retry_of name the same failure is accepted and its supplied block preserved

dependencies: WA-A5B-FUP1 (bundlebees #311, merged 7e60481): the attach step this slice hardens
bundlebees #307 (merged 805a37c) made ATTACH_FINDINGS dark by default and capped the attach; the approved RED sets ATTACH_FINDINGS=1 for the enabled-path tests and leaves the dark default untouched

RED commit 9289a861a968f198c535d9e75335ef51aee8173b is test-only on bundlebees main c8c9953: four failures prove the non-string id resolves to empty, the stray block survives a direct helper call, and the disagreeing explicit/retry_of ids are accepted; the two preservation pins pass at source_rev
assumptions: research_gate.require_findings is the single gate every dispatch path crosses, so the both-id rule belongs there rather than in each caller
the refusal code stays research_required: it is the code the dispatch envelope already carries for a retry the gate will not allow
no accepted artifact is ever modified; the fix only narrows which briefs are allowed through
ATTACH_FINDINGS stays dark by default; this slice changes only the enabled attach path and the shared gate, never the flag default

reasons: changes which retries the dispatch gate allows, on the research-before-retry path
two product files on the dispatch path; no contract, schema or evidence-format change
closes the three minors of the WA-A5B-FUP1 review; every branch fails closed
